mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(0) AS total, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN DATE(access_time) != CURDATE() AND access_time >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN total_time ELSE null END), 2) AS avg_response_time_7days, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(access_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS calls_yesterday, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(access_time) != CURDATE() AND access_time >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN CASE WHEN code = 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS calls_success_7days, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(access_time) != CURDATE() AND access_time >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN CASE WHEN code = 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS calls_failure_7days, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN code = 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(0)) * 100, 2) AS success_percentage, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN code = 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(0)) * 100, 2) AS failure_percentage, interface.total_count AS interface_total, SUM(CASE WHEN code = 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN code = 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failureCount FROM interface_log CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(id) AS total_count FROM interface_manage WHERE data_status = 0 ) interface WHERE interface_log.dept_id=#{deptId} AND interface.dept_id=#{deptId};
